xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5464: Video production skill set: Remotion, HyperFrames, OpenMontage and video-use packs, plus a 'video' pack group

plan.title: Video production skill set: Remotion, HyperFrames, OpenMontage and video-use packs, plus a 'video' pack group
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 24 files across exactly 6 subsystems (src/lib, src/cli, and four doc paths); within the finalize limits, listed here for reviewers.

narratives.Problem: The operator wants one video production skill bundle. Skill packs are one git repo each, the video skills come from four repos with four licenses, and three of the four fail or misread in today's preview: HyperFrames extraction runs the Git LFS smudge filter and dies on the LFS rate limit, OpenMontage's skills live under .agents/skills (0 found) and its AGPL license reads as unknown, and video-use's main skill is a root SKILL.md the scanner never sees.
narratives.Proposal: Fix extraction (skip LFS smudge, restrict archives to declared paths plus capability-probe paths), recognize GPL-family licenses by full name, support a known pack's root skill through manifest, update diff, launch selection and mount (with a video-use host notice and generated requirements.txt), add four commit-pinned known packs from eltmon forks with a frozen 38-skill OpenMontage curation, and add pack groups (built-in 'video', config skills.pack_groups) to pan skills set, pan skills pack add and pan handoff. Docs and changelog ship with it. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-5464.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No dashboard UI for pack groups or adding packs to a running conversation (PAN-5465 owns that).
- No group support in the overdeck MCP handoff tool or the conversations HTTP route.
- No new runtime adapter and no install step that runs pack code (video-use helpers run only when the agent invokes them, via uv).
- No removal of the operator's ~/.claude/skills symlinks or npx skills copies; docs explain the double listing.
- No change to the mount hash of any existing pack.
- No fork creation, no upstream issues or PRs, no push to any upstream repo.
- No video-shotcraft known pack.
- No change to the JSON output shape of pan skills pack list.
- No live check against the operator's real ~/.overdeck; live checks use an isolated OVERDECK_HOME.
- No raise of any file-size allowlist row.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin each known pack to its eltmon fork's main head on 2026-11-17 (remotion 3e20ac7, hyperframes 34f98e6, openmontage 2e003e6, video-use 43cfc56).
autoDecisions.rationale: The forks already exist; pinning the verified heads makes the skill counts, exclude list and archive paths in the PRD true by construction, matching the pstack and atlassian precedent of 40-hex pins.

autoDecisions.summary: OpenMontage mounts 38 skills: exclude duplicates/generic web skills, repo-maintenance skills, and skills whose description targets OpenMontage or whose body imports/runs OpenMontage code; keep elevenlabs, music-to-video, seedance-2-5 and gemini-omni.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo-bound skills fail outside an OpenMontage checkout; a frozen explicit list removes judgment from the executor, and per-skill toggles let the operator turn any excluded behavior back on via a checkout.

autoDecisions.summary: Archive paths are filtered to those that exist at the commit and always include capability-probe paths (.claude-plugin, hooks, .mcp.json, commands, agents, LICENSE, LICENSE.md).
autoDecisions.rationale: git archive exits 128 on an unmatched pathspec (verified), and a restricted archive would otherwise hide hooks or MCP servers from the trust preview.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills set --group writes nothing when any member pack is unregistered.
autoDecisions.rationale: All-or-nothing avoids a half-applied group that the operator must reason about; the error names the command that fixes it.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills pack list --json keeps its array shape; groups appear only in text output.
autoDecisions.rationale: Scripts parse the JSON array today; adding groups there would be a breaking change for no requested benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: No opt-in lists for the four video packs.
autoDecisions.rationale: Opt-in is reserved for skills that change Overdeck-owned files or push; none of the 62 mounted skills does, and paid-API skills do nothing without a key the operator sets.

Restrict pack extraction to declared archive paths plus capability-probe paths

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4, D-6, D-7. KnownPack gains archivePaths. sources.ts exports CAPABILITY_PROBE_PATHS = ['.claude-plugin','hooks','.mcp.json','commands','agents','LICENSE','LICENSE.md'] and adds archivePathsOf(id) next to pluginRootOf. extractCommit(id, commit, pluginRoot?, archivePaths?): assertOperand each path; effective = dedupe(archivePaths + probe paths) filtered by 'git --git-dir <repo> cat-file -e <commit>:<path>'; empty -> throw 'pack <id>: none of its archive paths exist at <commit>'; reuse an existing extraction only when every effective path exists in it, else rm and rebuild; pass ['--', ...effective] to git archive. Update all 7 extractCommit call sites (search 'extractCommit(id,') to pass archivePathsOf(id). git archive exits 128 on a missing pathspec, which is why the filter exists.

extractCommit rebuilds an existing extraction that lacks an effective path, and returns an existing extraction that contains all effective paths unchanged (same inode)
